headline: TRUMP: HUANG PARDON
dek: The president told the New York Post he does not think a pardon will be necessary.

nodes.text: Huang resigns as Nvidia president and CEO, the company announced.
Nvidia’s board reinstates him, citing “input from senior levels of the United States government.”
Shapiro: the White House’s intervention is a “political nuclear bomb.”
Trump tells the Post a Huang pardon is “always an option.”
Closed-door House interview, including Foreign Affairs.
Senate Banking public hearing on export controls.

means.label: What Trump said:
means.text: He told CNBC, “I believe my intervention was very important.”

means.label: The administration:
means.text: The White House said it has “no reason to believe” a national security risk. AG Blanche: no evidence of “unlawful conduct.”

means.label: The criticism:
means.text: Schumer and Warren objected. Cotton said the controversy is “just the tip of the iceberg” and Congress “has much to investigate.” Hearings: Dec. 1 and Dec. 3.

sources: Sources: Ben Shapiro on X, Nov. 23; Trump on CNBC via Fox News, Nov. 23; Nvidia newsroom, Nov. 12 and Nov. 23; New York Post, Nov. 24; Cotton on X, Nov. 23; Sens. Schumer and Warren; House Foreign Affairs; Senate Banking via The Hill and CNBC.
